Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0026 2026-06-09
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-06-09
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0029, TEAM-0005
Subject: Weekly ALPHA Review Moves to Wednesday
Decision: Starting 2026-06-17, DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA's weekly queue
review moves from Thursday to Wednesday at 11:20. The new appointment
gives station clerks time to gather follow-up papers before the end-of-week
desk handovers.
The calendar clerk will retain the previous Thursday entry as a dated schedule
change. Move invitations by role, including the program chair, owning-team
leads, records coordinator, and station desk representative. The invitation
must state that this meeting is for queue coordination and paperwork
decisions.
The controls folder used to explain the change is located through
DEMO-AIR-0003 and ISSUE-0071. TASK-0185 may identify a discussion
reference on the agenda; listing it here does not book a record for review.
Agenda headings are due to the chair by Tuesday at 16:00. An item arriving
after that cutoff should receive a named contact and the next discussion date,
even if it cannot fit the coming appointment. The desk must not treat a missed
agenda cutoff as a reason to lose ownership.
Implementation: PERSON-0029 will ask the calendar clerk to publish the
revised appointment on 2026-06-10. The station representatives will confirm
their receiving roles before the first Wednesday session. Record any recurring
attendance conflict beside the role so that the chair can arrange coverage
without shifting the meeting again informally.
D. Worker 0027
Demo Worker 0029, Demo Team 05
